claude_proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Sovereign Glue's core deterministic effect is creating a persistent adhesive bond between two objects. The current surface can target objects, track charges, and model action cost, but it has no effect atom for establishing an object-to-object bond.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: delayed_set_then_permanent_bond
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The glue is applied now, takes 1 minute to set, and only then becomes a permanent bond that persists until explicitly broken by named counteragents. The current activation family has no honest way to represent delayed object-state commitment followed by permanent persistence on the bonded pair.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set. Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness, or with a Wish spell.
